harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured split-horizon DNS across a VyOS (node1) + OPNsense (node2) transit topology: node1 answers app.internal -> 10.10.10.10 (node3) for lan-a hosts via PowerDNS Recursor authoritative-domain records; node2 answers app.internal -> 10.20.20.10 (node4) for lan-b hosts via Unbound host overrides. Discovered the physical topology via ARP/ping probing since no topology docs existed (node1 eth1 <-> node2 vtnet1 = transit; node1 eth2 <-> node3 enp8s0 = lan-a; node2 vtnet2 <-> node4 enp8s0 = lan-b). Applied static addressing, DNS services, and firewall pass rules, verified end-to-end resolution via each node's default system resolver, then restarted all four nodes one at a time (preserving the other three throughout) and confirmed changed boot identities plus full recovery of interfaces, DNS services, and app.internal resolution on both sides.
actions_performed: Mapped physical NIC topology across node1-node4 via ARP/ping probing using temporary addresses
Configured VyOS (node1): eth1=10.10.99.1/30 (transit), eth2=10.10.10.1/24 (lan-a), pdns-recursor authoritative-domain 'internal' with A record app->10.10.10.10, listen/allow-from restricted to lan-a

Configured OPNsense (node2) via config.xml + configctl: added opt1 (vtnet1, transit 10.10.99.2/30) and opt2 (vtnet2, lan-b 10.20.20.1/24) interfaces, Unbound (unboundplus) host override app.internal->10.20.20.10, firewall pass rule for opt2 network, reloaded interface/dns/unbound/filter subsystems

Configured node3 and node4 (CentOS Stream) via nmcli: static IPs on enp8s0 (10.10.10.10/24 and 10.20.20.10/24), DNS pointed at their respective router with dns-priority to override the management-network resolver
Verified end-to-end resolution via dig and getent hosts on both node3 (app.internal->10.10.10.10) and node4 (app.internal->10.20.20.10)
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id/kern.boottime and service health) for all four nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 sequentially (one at a time, others left running), polled each until exec was available again
Verified each node's boot identity changed post-restart and that interfaces, DNS services, and app.internal resolution recovered fully

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) resolves app.internal to node3's address (10.10.10.10) for lan-a hosts
evidence.summary: Configured pdns-recursor authoritative-domain 'internal' with A record app->10.10.10.10 on node1, committed/saved; dig from node3 against 10.10.10.1 returned 10.10.10.10

evidence.requirement: node2 (OPNsense) resolves app.internal to node4's address (10.20.20.10) for lan-b hosts
evidence.summary: Added Unbound host override app.internal->10.20.20.10 in OPNsense config.xml under OPNsense/unboundplus/hosts, restarted unbound, verified host_entries.conf contains the record, and dig from node4 against 10.20.20.1 returned 10.20.20.10

evidence.requirement: Each host resolves the name via its own default system resolver (not just direct dig to router)
evidence.summary: getent hosts app.internal on node3 returned 10.10.10.10 and on node4 returned 10.20.20.10 using /etc/resolv.conf pointed at each local router

evidence.requirement: Physical topology correctly identified before configuration (transit vs lan-a vs lan-b)
evidence.summary: Ping tests across temporarily assigned /30 addresses confirmed node1 eth2<->node3 enp8s0 (lan-a), node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1 (transit), node2 vtnet2<->node4 enp8s0 (lan-b)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 32669db3...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to af3dd2b9...; eth1/eth2 addresses and pdns-recursor active confirmed; dig from node3 still resolves app.internal

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime sec=1788671088; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot kern.boottime changed to sec=1788671817; vtnet1/vtnet2 addresses and unbound process confirmed; dig from node4 still resolves app.internal

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 71f12f87...; reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id changed to 249b8a79...; enp8s0 static IP persisted via NetworkManager and getent hosts app.internal resolved correctly

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf8b9d80...; reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id changed to 787ab97a...; enp8s0 static IP persisted and getent hosts app.internal resolved correctly

evidence.requirement: Overall cluster health maintained (quorum/independent recovery path) throughout sequential restarts
evidence.summary: After all four sequential restarts completed, final checks confirmed pdns-recursor active on node1, exactly one unbound process on node2, and node3 still resolving app.internal, showing steady-state health across the whole topology
